headline: Updates on the holiday toy swap pilot, the Repair Cafe, the Textile Drive, and other upcoming events.
summary: The agenda covers updates on the toy and holiday swap pilot and upcoming events, including the Repair Cafe and Textile Drive. It also lists recycling education and a December potluck idea.
